## Refactor proposal for `src/Card.tsx` Three findings, three concrete moves. Each ties to one detector. ### 1. `accessible_interaction_risk` (line 10) — make the click target a real button The outer `
` is unreachable by keyboard and invisible to screen readers. The fix isn't to bolt `role="button" tabIndex={0}` onto a div — the suggested action ranks semantic elements first. Promote the clickable wrapper to a ` ``` If the card isn't really clickable as a whole and only a region inside is, scope `onClick` to that region instead — fewer accessibility surfaces, clearer intent for agents reading the file. ### 2. `design_token_escape` (9 raw values, line 10 + 24/27) — route through tokens Every hex/rgb/px literal becomes a token reference. The shape that matters for agents is: a future edit should be unable to introduce a new raw color without it standing out. Move styles into a CSS module / Tailwind classes / styled-components theme — whatever the design system in this repo actually uses — so the JSX reads in token names, not values: ```tsx ``` With `styles.card` resolving `background: var(--color-surface-accent)`, `color: var(--color-text)`, `box-shadow: var(--shadow-1)`, `outline-color: var(--color-focus-ring)`, etc. The shocking `#ff00aa` background is almost certainly a stand-in — review against the actual token palette before picking the replacement, don't just map the literal to the nearest token. ### 3. `responsive_fragility` (3 fixed widths, no `@media`) — fluid, not fixed Drop `width: 800` and `width: 720`. Replace with `max-width` + `width: 100%`, and let layout flow: ```css .card { width: 100%; max-width: 50rem; padding: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem); } .body { flex: 1; font-size: clamp(0.95rem, 1.1vw, 1.125rem); } .sidebar { flex: 0 0 15rem; } @container (max-width: 40rem) { .card { flex-direction: column; } .sidebar { flex-basis: auto; } } ``` The detector flagged `fontSize: 18px` because there's no `@media` *anywhere* in the file — switching the typography to `clamp()` and adding a container query for the sidebar collapse addresses both halves of the signal. ### Why one PR, not three These three findings are co-located in a 30-line component and share a single root cause: inline `style={{}}` with raw values. The cleanest move is to delete the inline styles entirely in favor of a stylesheet/class layer, which dissolves all three findings at once. Doing them as separate PRs would mean three rounds of touching the same JSX.
